selection_rule: Lexicographically first eligible tuple(exact nonempty diseaseId, ordered DISTINCT targetId pair), each target has>=1 direct evidence row and union has>=2 distinct nonempty studyLocusId; no scores, effects, overlap pattern, gene or disease labels considered. Full100-shard projected ID scan.
metadata_policy: After deterministic binding, project scientific metadata only for matching source rows; read all source rowgroups needed for those rows, retain physical locators and report decode counts. No locus/ldSet arrays, current API, candidate/reference outputs, or backend.
